tagline: Your body is a temple. Honor it through how you live.
brief: Premium apparel for people who believe the body is a gift: not to be neglected, not to be worshipped, but to be stewarded. The mark already exists. This kit builds the system around that wordmark.
criteria: Success: the existing wordmark stays intact, reads in one colour, and the O can stand alone at favicon size.

concepts.name: OBT wordmark
concepts.idea: The live wordmark: one stroke that draws the O, runs across as the bar, and becomes B and T.
rationale: Traced from the existing thin white logo, not redrawn
Works in one colour, black or white
The O, measured from the same artwork, is the small-size mark

recommendation: Keep the existing wordmark. Use the O only where the full mark cannot fit.
next_steps: Use the SVG masters for print and the web icon set for the site
Do not redraw the wordmark in a font
Verify Ember against a physical Pantone swatch before embroidery
